divider-what-v2.svg: 01 WHAT IT DOES. ONE TILE PER TARGET.
divider-how-v2.svg: 03 HOW IT WORKS. ONE LOST CHECK IS NOT RED.
lead-v2-dark.svg: synthwerk-pulse is the platform's view of itself. It checks every service and infra part from targets.yaml and streams a stable status per target over Server-Sent Events.
lead-v2-light.svg: synthwerk-pulse is the platform's view of itself. It checks every service and infra part from targets.yaml and streams a stable status per target over Server-Sent Events.
stats-v2-dark.svg: 2 CHECK KINDS: HTTP AND TCP. 30 s LIMIT TO SHOW A STOPPED PART. 50 OPEN STREAMS PER PROCESS. 1 EVENT PER STORED CHANGE
stats-v2-light.svg: 2 CHECK KINDS: HTTP AND TCP. 30 s LIMIT TO SHOW A STOPPED PART. 50 OPEN STREAMS PER PROCESS. 1 EVENT PER STORED CHANGE
features-v2-dark.svg: CHECK: Kind http sends GET to a URL. Kind tcp connects to host:port. One target per box. HOLD: A status changes only after a run of equal results. One lost check stays green. STREAM: Server-Sent Events: a snapshot first, then one event per change. A ping every 15 s
features-v2-light.svg: CHECK: Kind http sends GET to a URL. Kind tcp connects to host:port. One target per box. HOLD: A status changes only after a run of equal results. One lost check stays green. STREAM: Server-Sent Events: a snapshot first, then one event per change. A ping every 15 s
what-v2-dark.svg: Targets file: Pulse reads SYNTHWERK_PULSE_TARGETS_FILE at start. No API adds a target. Max 64 targets. http: A /readyz body from openapi/_shared/health.yaml gives status and checks. Other 2xx or 3xx is ok. down: A 4xx, a 5xx, a timeout or a refused connection is down. Pulse follows no redirect. tcp: Opens a TCP connection to host:port. For parts without a health endpoint, such as Postgres. Stored: The last status per target sits in pulse_target_status. The event goes to the outbox in the same transaction. Fast: Compose infra targets poll every 5 s. A stopped part shows as down in about 10 to 15 s
what-v2-light.svg: Targets file: Pulse reads SYNTHWERK_PULSE_TARGETS_FILE at start. No API adds a target. Max 64 targets. http: A /readyz body from openapi/_shared/health.yaml gives status and checks. Other 2xx or 3xx is ok. down: A 4xx, a 5xx, a timeout or a refused connection is down. Pulse follows no redirect. tcp: Opens a TCP connection to host:port. For parts without a health endpoint, such as Postgres. Stored: The last status per target sits in pulse_target_status. The event goes to the outbox in the same transaction. Fast: Compose infra targets poll every 5 s. A stopped part shows as down in about 10 to 15 s
start-v2-dark.svg: Terminal: # in synthwerk-infra | $ scripts/init-env.sh && docker compose up --wait | $ curl -N http://127.0.0.1:8080/pulse/v1/health/stream | event: snapshot | # stop a container: a status event says down
start-v2-light.svg: Terminal: # in synthwerk-infra | $ scripts/init-env.sh && docker compose up --wait | $ curl -N http://127.0.0.1:8080/pulse/v1/health/stream | event: snapshot | # stop a container: a status event says down
setup-v2-dark.svg: just test-unit: Status, check, target, stream and monitor tests in tests/unit. No Docker. just test-int: Store, outbox and live status against real Postgres and NATS. Needs Docker. just image: Build the container image as CI builds it. just lint: gofmt, golangci-lint, actionlint and zizmor
setup-v2-light.svg: just test-unit: Status, check, target, stream and monitor tests in tests/unit. No Docker. just test-int: Store, outbox and live status against real Postgres and NATS. Needs Docker. just image: Build the container image as CI builds it. just lint: gofmt, golangci-lint, actionlint and zizmor
startnotes-v2-dark.svg: Needs: Go 1.27. Docker for just test-int and just image. just runs the same commands as CI. Own targets: Start from targets.example.yaml. Set the targets file, database URL and NATS URL
startnotes-v2-light.svg: Needs: Go 1.27. Docker for just test-int and just image. just runs the same commands as CI. Own targets: Start from targets.example.yaml. Set the targets file, database URL and NATS URL
flow-v2-dark.svg: TARGET -> CHECK -> HOLD -> STREAM. A change goes to the open streams at once, also when Postgres is down.
flow-v2-light.svg: TARGET -> CHECK -> HOLD -> STREAM. A change goes to the open streams at once, also when Postgres is down.
how-v2-dark.svg: To down: After 2 down results in a row, from any status. Back up: From down to ok or degraded after 3 results in a row that are not down. Degraded: From ok to degraded at once. Back to ok after 2 ok results in a row. First: From unknown to ok or degraded after 1 result that is not down. Restart: No event again: pulse writes an event only when the stored status differs
how-v2-light.svg: To down: After 2 down results in a row, from any status. Back up: From down to ok or degraded after 3 results in a row that are not down. Degraded: From ok to degraded at once. Back to ok after 2 ok results in a row. First: From unknown to ok or degraded after 1 result that is not down. Restart: No event again: pulse writes an event only when the stored status differs
api-v2-dark.svg: GET /healthz: Liveness of the process. GET /readyz: Readiness. postgres and nats are critical. GET /v1/health: The snapshot as one JSON document. GET /v1/health/stream: SSE: snapshot first, then status per change, : ping every 15 s. Max 50 streams, then 503. 1 h lifetime. local edge: http://127.0.0.1:8080/pulse/v1/health/stream
api-v2-light.svg: GET /healthz: Liveness of the process. GET /readyz: Readiness. postgres and nats are critical. GET /v1/health: The snapshot as one JSON document. GET /v1/health/stream: SSE: snapshot first, then status per change, : ping every 15 s. Max 50 streams, then 503. 1 h lifetime. local edge: http://127.0.0.1:8080/pulse/v1/health/stream
events-v2-dark.svg: Type: dev.synthwerk.pulse.target.status_changed.v1, one per stored change. Path: Transactional outbox to NATS JetStream stream EVT_PULSE, with the Go kit from synthwerk-contracts go/v0.1.0
events-v2-light.svg: Type: dev.synthwerk.pulse.target.status_changed.v1, one per stored change. Path: Transactional outbox to NATS JetStream stream EVT_PULSE, with the Go kit from synthwerk-contracts go/v0.1.0
config-v2-dark.svg: SYNTHWERK_PULSE_DATABASE_URL: Postgres URL. Required. A secret: never in the repo. SYNTHWERK_PULSE_NATS_URL: NATS JetStream URL. SYNTHWERK_PULSE_TARGETS_FILE: The targets file. Read at start. SYNTHWERK_PULSE_HTTP_ADDR: Listen address. Default :8080. SYNTHWERK_PULSE_DEFAULT_INTERVAL: Check interval. Default 15s. 1 s to 5 min. SYNTHWERK_PULSE_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT: Check timeout. Default 3s. Max the interval and 10 s. SYNTHWERK_PULSE_SSE_MAX_CLIENTS: Max open streams. Default 50
